rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person, attitude, or mood that expects a positive outcome.

example.english: Even when plans do not go as hoped, I’m still optimistic.
example.traditional: 就算計劃未如理想，我都仲係好樂觀。
example.jyutping: zau6 syun3 gai3 waak6 mei6 jyu4 lei5 soeng2 ngo5 dou1 zung6 hai6 hou2 lok6 gun1

rows.note: Use this when saying that you expect a particular person, team, plan, or outcome to do well.

example.english: I’m optimistic about our team winning this match.
example.traditional: 今場比賽我好睇好我哋隊贏波。
example.jyutping: gam1 coeng4 bei2 coi3 ngo5 hou2 tai2 hou2 ngo5 dei6 deoi6 jeng4 bo1
